subject: Decision Making
title: The HiPPO Problem
description: A quick, practical guide to The HiPPO Problem.

hook.text: HiPPO stands for Highest Paid Person's Opinion. In most meetings, the senior person speaks and everyone agrees.

buildup.text: Status bias is powerful. Junior team members defer to authority even when they have better information.

discovery.text: HiPPO decisions waste the team's collective knowledge. The group functions as one brain instead of benefiting from many.

twist.text: Amazon fights HiPPO with written memos read silently before discussion.

climax.text: The fix is structural: collect input before the leader speaks.

punchline.text: Boss speaks, room follows. Collect input before the leader talks to avoid HiPPO.

quiz.question: How can teams prevent the HiPPO problem?
options: Collect input from everyone before the leader speaks their opinion
